metadata.question: Was the soil in Washington more moist on November 22, 2021 than November 15, 2021?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about soil moisture in Washington (likely the state) between two specific dates in November 2021. For soil moisture, I should use SMAP (Soil Moisture Active Passive) data, which provides soil moisture measurements. Key considerations: 1. Data source: NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP_E collection for soil moisture 2. Time period: November 15, 2021 and November 22, 2021 3. Location: Washington state - I'll use a polygon covering the state 4. Processing: Need to extract soil moisture values and compare between dates 5. Validation: Check if images exist and if we get valid pixel counts I'll use the 'soil_moisture_am' band from SMAP which provides morning soil moisture measurements. The logic: - Get SMAP images for both dates - Check if collections have data (C1 if empty) - Calculate mean soil moisture over Washington for both dates - Check if we get valid pixel counts (C2 if 0) - Compare the values and output A/B - Handle any calculation failures (C3) For Washington state geometry, I'll use a rough polygon that covers the state boundaries. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Washington state geometry (rough polygon) const washington = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-124.7, 48.2], [-124.7, 45.5], [-116.9, 45.5], [-116.9, 49.0], [-124.7, 48.2] ]); // Define dates const date1 = '2021-11-15'; const date2 = '2021-11-22'; // Get SMAP soil moisture data const smap1 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP_E') .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(washington); const smap2 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP_E') .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(washington); // Check collection sizes const count1 = smap1.size().getInfo(); const count2 = smap2.size().getInfo(); print(`${date1} Images: ${count1}`); print(`${date2} Images: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Get first image from each collection const img1 = smap1.first(); const img2 = smap2.first(); // Extract soil moisture values const soilMoisture1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: washington, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('soil_moisture_am'); const soilMoisture2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: washington, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('soil_moisture_am'); // Get pixel counts for validation const countPixels1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: washington, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('soil_moisture_am'); const countPixels2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: washington, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('soil_moisture_am'); const sm1 = soilMoisture1.getInfo(); const sm2 = soilMoisture2.getInfo(); const px1 = countPixels1.getInfo(); const px2 = countPixels2.getInfo(); print(`Nov 15 Soil Moisture: ${sm1 ? sm1.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${px1}`); print(`Nov 22 Soil Moisture: ${sm2 ? sm2.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${px2}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (px1 === 0 || px2 === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (sm1 === null || sm2 === null || isNaN(sm1) || isNaN(sm2)) { print("C3"); return; } // Compare soil moisture values if (sm2 > sm1) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
